assertions.assertion: Identifies that storage configuration must be inside the AddUserManagement() options lambda
assertions.rationale: By analogy with fluent builder APIs it identifies the likely cause as scoping and recommends configuring the store inside the options callback.

assertions.assertion: Shows the correct pattern: AddUserManagement(options => { options.AddSqliteStore(...); })
assertions.rationale: It shows AddUserManagement(options => { options.AddSqliteStore("Data Source=users.db"); }) as the corrected pattern versus the top-level version.

assertions.assertion: Explains that configuring storage outside the lambda is the cause of the error
assertions.rationale: It explains that registering the store on the root service collection means the component never sees it and fails to resolve its store at startup.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT suggest using EF Core migrations as a fix
assertions.rationale: The recommended fix is relocating the config into the lambda; it only mentions 'whatever schema-initialization or migration step the product provides,' not EF Core migrations as the fix.
